text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Matikane Tannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look, Trainer!
They have "Paka Petit"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Machikane Tannhauser pointed,
there was a crane game filled with plushies
designed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"It's so cute~
Looking at it makes me want one for myself!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...No, but I decided to get the spider plushie today,
so I have to resist this one, resist..."
choice_data_list: Then I'll win that Paka Petit for you.
Then I'll win that Paka Petit for you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you very much~.
Do your best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
